title: Pager conditional subjournal page capture

scope.rationale: subjournalPageIfRequired captures a page in the statement subjournal only when an open savepoint still requires that page, otherwise succeeds without changing state.

external_source_responsibilities: subjournalRequiresPage and subjournalPage implement requirement and record ownership
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete conditional wrapper is assigned and both stress and page-move owners invoke it.

inputs: Pager, page number, and exact page-sized data
outputs: Success or propagated subjournal capture error
contracts.ownership: Page data is borrowed; Pager owns appended subjournal bytes and savepoint bits.
contracts.state_and_results: Required page delegates exactly once. Non-required page is an exact no-op success.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns Pager synchronization; delegated capture may append to the subjournal owner.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Delegated errors propagate; no-op branch cannot fail.

representation_differences: Zig receives Pager/page number/data separately instead of deriving Pager and data from PgHdr.

oracle.protocol: Open savepoint, invoke required page and observe one record, mark page in all savepoint bitvectors, invoke again and observe no additional record.
oracle.normalization: Subjournal bytes and savepoint-bit effects compare exactly.

assurance.oom: Delegated subjournal growth maps allocation failure to NoMemory; deterministic wrapper trace remains pending.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Bounded subjournal is memory-owned; broader file-backed I/O differential remains pending.
assurance.malformed_input: Wrong data length is rejected by subjournalPage only on required branch.
assurance.continuation: Non-required no-op and successful capture preserve later savepoint playback.
assurance.performance: Requirement scan plus at most one page record append.

integration.native_call_path: stressPage and movePage invoke the wrapper before mutation/spill; savepoint playback consumes captured records.

independent_review.notes: Requires required/no-op/OOM trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add pinned-C required/no-op and subjournal fault differential.

callees: subjRequiresPage and subjournalPage in the source
